info.title: Lupira Photo API
info.description: Family photo/video library backend for Lupira: presigned uploads, geotagging, map queries. Authenticate with a Bearer token issued by the OIDC provider (Authentik).

get.summary: The caller's resolved local identity (JIT-provisioned on first login).

post.summary: Declare an asset (idempotent) and receive a presigned upload URL while bytes are pending.

get.summary: List assets (keyset-paged, newest taken first by default) with presigned thumbnail URLs. trashed=true lists only the trash.

post.summary: Verify the uploaded bytes and queue processing (idempotent).
Re-queue a Ready or Failed asset through the processing pipeline.
Move an asset to the trash (idempotent). It keeps its bytes and status until restored or purged.
Take an asset back out of the trash (idempotent).
Hydrate up to 200 assets by id — turns relation references into renderable items.

get.summary: Library totals and counts by kind, status, geotag source and month.
Imported event folders and albums with their core date span, for linking to calendar events.
Place labels by asset count, most used first — suggestions for the place filter (q = substring).
Geotagged Ready assets in a viewport as GeoJSON: a point per photo when at most 200 are in view or zoom >= 17, else a point per grid cell with its count.
Measured-location Ready photos per ~100 m cell with their distinct UTC days, most days first.
One asset with presigned original + thumbnail URLs.

patch.summary: Hand-set metadata (the photographer); outranks anything derived.

delete.summary: Delete an asset permanently, trashed or not: objects first, then the document.

put.summary: Hand-set the location; outranks the file's own GPS and survives reprocessing.

delete.summary: Drop a hand-set location and re-queue the asset so its geotag is re-derived (idempotent).

post.summary: Hand-set one location on every asset a selector matches (ids, or a time window narrowed by camera and current coordinate). dryRun previews.

put.summary: Hand-set the capture time; outranks every derived time and survives import re-runs.

delete.summary: Drop a hand-set capture time and restore the derived one (idempotent).

post.summary: Shift or set the capture time of every asset a selector matches (ids, or a time window narrowed by camera and device). dryRun previews before/after.
Report impossible GPS fixes per camera: speed spikes and coordinates repeated across days. apply rejects the spikes and the listed coordinates, and re-queues them.

delete.summary: Drop a GPS rejection and re-queue the asset so its fix is used again (idempotent).

requiredHeaders.description: Headers the PUT must echo — they are part of the presigned signature.

DeclaredPhotoResponse.description:
Declare outcome. UploadUrl is present only while the asset still needs bytes (status
            Declared); an already-uploaded asset returns its status so the client skips the transfer.

capturedByContactId.description: The photographer's contact — the phone sends its owner's own contact.

DeclarePhotoRequest.description:
Client-side MediaStore metadata for one asset. (DeviceId, MediaStoreId) under the caller is
            the idempotency key — retrying a declare returns the same asset.

GpsRejectionDto.description: A fix the GPS sweep rejected; processing skips it until restored.

camera.description: The phone's device id, else the EXIF camera name.

GpsRepeatDto.description: One coordinate one camera reported on several days.

camera.description: The phone's device id, else the EXIF camera name.

apply.description: Reject and re-queue; without it the sweep only reports.

rejectCoordinates.description: Repeated coordinates to reject too (within ~1 m), as reported under repeats.

GpsSweepRequest.description:
Finds impossible GPS fixes among Ready photos with exact capture times, per camera. Spikes are
            rejected on apply; repeated coordinates only when listed in List<GpsCoordinateDto>? GpsSweepRequest.RejectCoordinates.

rejected.description: Assets rejected and re-queued; 0 unless applied.

rejectedIds.description: The rejected assets, for a restore; at most 2000.

GpsSweepResponse.description: Counts over everything scanned; List<GpsSpikeDto> GpsSweepResponse.Spikes and List<GpsRepeatDto> GpsSweepResponse.Repeats are capped samples.

LookupPhotosRequest.description:
Hydrates a set of asset ids in one call — used to turn calendar-item relation references
            into renderable items.

MeDto.description: The resolved local identity of the caller.

source.description: The import source (`handelser`, `takeout`, …); null for phone assets.

folderDate.description: The date the folder name carries, when it has one.

coreFrom.description: The densest run of exactly-dated capture days; null when no photo has an exact date.

outliers.description: Photos outside the core run, or dated only approximately.

PhotoAlbumDto.description: One imported event folder or album, summarised for linking to a calendar event.

duplicateOfId.description: On a Duplicate only: the asset that holds the bytes.

purgesAt.description: When the trash is purged of it (`TrashedAt` + retention); null unless trashed.

thumbUrl.description: Presigned GET, long expiry; null until processed.

originalUrl.description: Presigned GET, short expiry; only on the single-asset endpoint.

PhotoDensityCellDto.description: The photos in one ~100 m cell: coordinates rounded to 3 decimals.

lastError.description: Only set on a Failed asset — lets the health view explain itself without a per-item fetch.

duplicateOfId.description: On a Duplicate only: the asset that holds the bytes.

purgesAt.description: When the trash is purged of it (`TrashedAt` + retention); null unless trashed.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor; absent on the last page.

thumbUrl.description: The photo's, or a cell's newest photo's.

bounds.description: A cell's photo extent, [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] — where tapping it zooms to.

PhotoMapPropertiesDto.description: One photo when the count is 1, else a grid cell drawn as a count bubble.

PhotoMapResponse.description: GeoJSON-shaped map payload — feeds a MapLibre GeoJSON source directly.

byCamera.description: "Sony G8341" → count; what the importer's camera map is built from.

label.description: A curated place name; omit to reverse-geocode the coordinates.

atLatitude.description: Only assets currently at this coordinate (within ~1 m); pairs with double? RelocatePhotosRequest.AtLongitude.

dryRun.description: Report what would move without changing anything.

RelocatePhotosRequest.description:
Hand-sets one location on every asset the selector matches — e.g. all of one camera's photos in a
            window that carry the same stale GPS fix. Needs List<Guid>? RelocatePhotosRequest.Ids or both DateTimeOffset? RelocatePhotosRequest.From and
            DateTimeOffset? RelocatePhotosRequest.To; the other criteria narrow further. Duplicates and trashed assets are never matched.

placeLabel.description: The label the moved assets now show; null on a dry run.

shiftBy.description: Added to each current time, signed (`-01:00:00`, `1.00:00:00`).

cameraModel.description: The EXIF camera model, case-insensitive (`HTC Desire`).

deviceId.description: The uploading device, or an import source (`import:handelser`).

dryRun.description: Report the before/after times without changing anything.

RetimePhotosRequest.description:
Hand-sets the capture time of every asset the selector matches — e.g. one camera's photos in a window
            its clock ran wrong. Give exactly one of TimeSpan? RetimePhotosRequest.ShiftBy or DateTimeOffset? RetimePhotosRequest.SetTo. Needs List<Guid>? RetimePhotosRequest.Ids
            or both DateTimeOffset? RetimePhotosRequest.From and DateTimeOffset? RetimePhotosRequest.To; the other criteria narrow further. Trashed assets are never
            matched, nor are duplicates in a window.

label.description: A curated place name; omit to reverse-geocode the coordinates.

SetPhotoLocationRequest.description: A hand-set location; outranks the file's own GPS until cleared.

SetPhotoTakenAtRequest.description: A hand-set capture time; outranks every derived time and survives import re-runs until cleared.

TakenAtSource.description:
Where DateTimeOffset PhotoAsset.TakenAt came from. TakenAtSource.Device is first so documents
            written before the field existed (phone backups) read as it.

UpdatePhotoRequest.description: Hand-set metadata. A null contact records the photographer as deliberately unknown.

Bearer.description: OIDC bearer token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
